blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— A Change.Org petition has been launched seeking improved mobile phone signal and internet connectivity at the Batangas Passenger Terminal, citing passengers’ growing reliance on digital services while traveling. The petition, titled “Improve Mobile Signal and Internet Connectivity at Batangas Passenger Terminal,” calls on the Philippine Ports Authority (PPA), terminal operator Asian Terminals Inc.
